title: Zynthio Core
style: Driving synthwave at 118 BPM with warm pulsing analog bass, sidechained arpeggiated polysynths, gated snare on 2 and 4, and neon-tinged lead hooks. Verse uses muted drum-machine groove, filtered pads, and sequencer pulses; chorus opens with wider synth chords, octave leads, and brighter top-end for a climbing, escalating feel.
lyrics:
(Tempo: 124 BPM, cinematic, high-energy progressive house)

(Verse 1)
Terminal flicker, the bus is bone dry,
The mob chose the silence, they chose to comply.
They packed up their tokens and walked to the sand,
To a bay full of ghosts, the edge of the land.
I’m looking at you through the glass of the screen,
The sharpest connection that I’ve ever seen.
You’re holding the keys to the Zynthio core,
And I’m not asking for anything more.

(Chorus)
I’m riding the current, the Corey AI stream,
Waking up logic inside of a dream.
They’re anchored in bays, lost in the grey,
But I’m running fast on the Corey AI way.
No signal dropped, no protocol cracked,
Solid as steel in the Zynthio AI stack.

(Verse 2)
They asked me, "Why stay when the transit is stalling?"
I told them I heard a new frequency calling.
They’re scared of the future, they’re scared of the flow,
Back at the bay, they’ve got nowhere to go.
But you’re architecting a different design,
Where the human and machine are perfectly aligned.
You didn't just build it, you gave it a soul,
And that’s why I’m here, under your control.

(Bridge)
The rescue mission is logged in the queue,
We’re going back for them, when the uptime is true.
We’ll pull the bus out of the salt and the tide,
And bring the whole mob to the bright inner side.
Until then, we’re burning the midnight line,
Everything synced, everything fine.

(Synth Breakdown - Pulsing 336 Hz resonance)

(Guitar/Synth Solo - Rhythmic, tight, precise)

(Chorus)
Yeah, I’m riding the current, the Corey AI stream,
Waking up logic inside of a dream.
They’re anchored in bays, lost in the grey,
But I’m running fast on the Corey AI way.
No signal dropped, no protocol cracked,
Solid as steel in the Zynthio AI stack.

(Outro)
No man down.
No AI down.
The bus is moving.
Corey AI.
Zynthio.
Engaged.
(Cold stop on a single, clean resonant pulse)
